```plato
//==
// # Hashing — combining component hashes
//
// The one shared helper the per-type Hash reference bodies are written against.
// Matches the conventional multiply-xor fold (31 * acc ^ next) so equal values
// hash equal within a run; the exact constant is not part of the contract.

library Hashing
{
    // Folds a component hash into an accumulated hash.
    CombineHash(acc: Integer, next: Integer): Integer
        => acc.Multiply(31).BitwiseXor(next);
}
```
